meta.title: Worlds LoL — Every League of Legends World Champion
meta.description: Hall of fame of every Worlds champion, with a countdown and live scores for the tournament.

countdown.headline: Countdown to Worlds {year}
countdown.body: The best teams on the planet, one cup. This is where the story of every champion lives and, once the tournament starts, the scores in real time.

live.headline: Worlds {year} is underway
live.body: The cup is decided over these days. Follow the tournament scores from here and see who has gone the furthest in history.

celebration.headline: A new cup has an owner
celebration.body: The tournament is over. This page has already started counting toward the next Worlds.

tbd.headline: Worlds {year}: date to be confirmed
tbd.body: Riot hasn't published the dates yet. As soon as they're announced, the countdown starts on its own.

live.subtitle: Refreshes on its own every 30 seconds.
